nodes.text: State Internal Transit. Viktor Sencik speaking. Authorization code X-909.

answers.reply: You already have everything required for authorization.

nodes.text: You are not cleared for operational details.

answers.text: Ask why State Internal is involved
answers.reply: Because local officers failed to contain the situation.

nodes.text: There was unauthorized radio activity near the relay villages.

answers.reply: That depends on how cooperative the suspects decide to be.

answers.text: Ask if civilians are in danger
answers.reply: Civilians become endangered when they interfere with state stability.
You are delaying an active operation.

nodes.text: Illegal transmitters. Printed materials. A few recording tapes.

answers.reply: False information. Panic. Encouragement of unrest.

nodes.text: Someone leaked restricted transmissions outside the border.

answers.text: Ask if they found the source
Ask what happens when they do
answers.reply: That depends on whether the individual cooperates.

nodes.text: You sound nervous, operator.

answers.reply: Your pauses became longer after I mentioned arrests.
You should avoid involving yourself emotionally.

nodes.text: You would be surprised how quickly ordinary people become dangerous once they think nobody is listening.

answers.text: Ask if he listens to operators too

nodes.text: Most people believe they are invisible right before they disappear.

answers.text: Ask if he is threatening you
answers.reply: No, {PLAYER_NAME}. If I wanted to threaten you, this conversation would feel very different.

nodes.text: You know the kind. Stories about protests. Missing workers. Dead civilians.

answers.text: Ask if the stories were false
answers.reply: Truth is a matter for state interpretation.

nodes.text: Leaking information across the border is considered treason now.

answers.reply: You understand the seriousness of the situation.

nodes.text: People usually cooperate once they understand how alone they really are.
You should be careful with that.
Silence is usually the smarter option.
Operators hear many things. Sometimes they repeat them.

answers.text: Ask what happens to those operators

answers.reply: You are not one of those operators, I assume.

nodes.text: Your file says you adapt quickly under pressure. I hope that assessment was correct.

answers.text: Ask how he knows your file
answers.reply: State Internal has access to many things.
Do not make this difficult for yourself.

nodes.text: The public does not need truth. It needs stability.
Unofficially? People stop asking where they were sent.

answers.reply: You should process my authorization now.

nodes.text: People who hesitate around simple decisions tend to attract attention.

answers.reply: This should be a simple decision.

nodes.text: Different station. Different office. Sometimes no office at all.

answers.reply: I would avoid unnecessary complications if I were you.

nodes.text: Including your employment record, {PLAYER_NAME}.
My authorization is valid. Any delay will be documented.

answers.reply: Good. You made the correct decision.
Do as you wish {PLAYER_NAME}. We will meet again...
